tasks.label: TrustFarm: Check stack health
tasks.command: curl -s http://localhost:8000/health; echo; curl -s http://localhost:8001/health; echo; curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'web:%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:3000

tasks.label: TrustFarm: Android emulator
tasks.detail: Boot the Pixel 10 Pro AVD and wait until Android reports boot complete
tasks.command: $HOME/Library/Android/sdk/emulator/emulator -avd Pixel_10_Pro -no-boot-anim & $HOME/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb wait-for-device; until [ "$($HOME/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')" = "1" ]; do sleep 2; done; echo 'Android emulator ready'

tasks.label: TrustFarm: iOS simulator
tasks.detail: Boot the iPhone 17 simulator and wait until it is ready
tasks.command: xcrun simctl boot 32CBE114-5C15-436F-9702-914B90ED33B5 2>/dev/null; open -a Simulator; xcrun simctl bootstatus 32CBE114-5C15-436F-9702-914B90ED33B5 -b; echo 'iOS simulator ready'
